prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reordering (1 test).
Evidence is still thin for home redesigns (1 test).
Evidence is still thin for finish layout changes (1 test).
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy changes (1 test).
Predictions were consistently too high across all tested changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the friend selection screen into a side-by-side split layout with a prominent pet visual preview and trait list. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate of 39.1% (60.9% conversion) and long median completion time (89s), pointing to selection friction.)
1: [finish, new_screen] First Desktop Controls Intro Screen: Insert a short controls introduction screen right before the final welcome screen explaining basic pet interactions. (why: Support received multiple emails from confused users asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Safety Hint: Add an explicit account safety hint on the sign-in screen explaining that pets and progress are automatically backed up. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in, indicating high user concern around account data loss.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time Estimate & Alert: Enable time estimates and readiness notifications on the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), leading users to assume the app has frozen.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Card Grid Redesign: Redesign path selection into structured choice cards with clear visual highlights for standard vs custom pet flows. (why: choose_path shows a 76.2% conversion with a high mean duration (514s), suggesting path decision uncertainty.)
5: [finish, redesign] Desktop Placement Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight layout highlighting desktop overlay permissions and taskbar placement. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets failing to display on desktop after setup, while finish screen conversion is only 64.8%.)
6: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Progress Counter: Display a progress counter and explicit saving tip on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion in the core funnel (60.9%), causing user drop-off right before waiting.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Value Proposition Copy Update: Revise sign-in headline and body text to clearly convey why account creation is needed before adoption. (why: sign_in loses 27.1% of users with an 8-minute mean completion time, plus bug reports of stalled user flow.)

scores.note: Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%), but redesigns have shown poor or uncertain performance in past tests.
Strong evidence from support emails and drop-off, though inserting a new screen requires full release cost.
High evidence from 8 support tickets and drop-off; simple hint addition carries low implementation overhead.
Addresses major waiting time latency perception (201s median), supported by funnel metrics.
High decision time on choose_path, but visual redesign carries zero-confidence baseline from historical tests.
Finish stage drop-off and 3 support tickets, but previous finish layout redesign resulted in negative lift (-2.5%).
Targets the highest drop-off step (adoption 60.9%) with a safe progress/hint mechanism.
Config-only copy change for sign_in friction supported by stalled flow reports.
